key.name: dictation-shortcut
key.description: Hold it to dictate; tap it to toggle hands-free dictation.

key.name: mode
key.description: auto: hold the modifier to dictate, tap to toggle. hold: release always stops. toggle: the shortcut starts and stops.

key.name: tap-ms
key.description: Releasing the modifier within this many milliseconds counts as a tap (toggle mode).

key.name: silence-stop-s
key.description: In hands-free mode, stop after this many seconds of silence. 0 = never.

key.name: microphone
key.description: PipeWire node name of the microphone to record from. Empty = the system default input.

key.name: polish
key.description: Send each finished block through the local LLM (llama.cpp, installed with the voice commands) to fix punctuation and casing. Off = pure offline recognition.

key.name: welcome-shown
key.description: Whether the first-run check for the speech engine has run.

key.name: show-indicator
key.description: Show an icon and menu in the GNOME Shell top bar.

key.name: show-hud
key.description: Show the microphone level and live text while dictating.

key.name: hud-position
key.description: island: a capsule that slides out of the top bar, always in the same place. cursor: next to the text cursor (the pointer when the application does not report one).

key.name: hud-effect
key.description: How the pill appears and disappears. swell: a bump swells out of the bar. drop: a drop falls from the bar and springs open. spring: the capsule zooms out of the bar and wobbles. glow: swell with a halo.

key.name: hud-preview
key.description: Changed by the preferences to make the extension show the pill once, to preview its animation.

key.name: commands-enabled
key.description: Optional: a second shortcut to say what to do (open an application, change a setting, run a shell command after confirmation). Needs the command helper of the speech engine.

key.name: command-shortcut
key.description: Hold it and say what to do; tap it for hands-free listening. Only bound while commands-enabled is on.

key.name: command-llm
key.summary: Use the local LLM for commands
key.description: Send the requests the rules do not understand (shell commands, questions) to the language model that the command helper runs on this computer. Off: only the built-in GNOME actions.

key.name: command-work-dir
key.description: Where confirmed commands run. Empty = the home folder.

key.name: command-speak
key.description: Say the result of a command aloud with the engine's voice (installed by: voice-hold-engine setup --tts). A command's output is summarised by the local LLM first.

key.name: command-voice
key.description: fr or en. Empty: follows the session language.
